summary: Surveyed all 282 listed files (all .lean; 153 FirstOrder, 57 ProvabilityLogic, 32 Vorspiel, 13 Propositional, 8 Logic, 6 Meta, 5 Syntax, 4 SecondOrder, Foundation.lean, 3 Zoo) with a per-file declaration/command grep; all 282 exist in the checkout and together hold about 6433 theorem/lemma lines. Twelve files had zero declaration-or-command matches; I read each completely and all are prover-aware import-only aggregators (module + public import lines) or small executables with a def main, so they stay primary-eligible under FILTER-007 (no verified auxiliary delivery path). Remaining files carry theorem/def/instance/example content. No file meets the FILTER-002/FILTER-004 bar for exclusion; all 282 files are retained.

summary: Inspected all 3 changed/added files in the work unit. Foundation/FirstOrder/Arithmetic/Examples.lean (51 lines) contains instance declarations establishing equivalence and weaker-than relations between arithmetic theory fragments (BSigma, ISigma, BPi, IPi, LSigma, LPi, IBroadSigma, PA). Foundation/FirstOrder/Arithmetic/Schemata.lean (908 lines) defines induction, least number, and collection schemata with their prenex/broad hierarchy variants (ISigma, IPi, IBroadSigma, IBroadPi, LSigma, LPi, BSigma, BPi), plus extensive lemmas about subset/weaker-than relations and model-theoretic properties. Foundation/FirstOrder/Incompleteness/Reflection/Local.lean (204 lines) formalizes local reflection principles Rfn_Γ(T), their relation to consistency, soundness, and unboundedness over finite extensions. All three files contain substantial formal mathematical content — definitions, lemmas, theorems, instances, and abbreviations — not pure import aggregators.
